title: Same stale COSE hex in key_rotation_attestation.py:151
description: Review finding (b7z9.37(d) round, surfaced by two independent passes): python/src/lichen/crypto/key_rotation_attestation.py:151 docstring shows protected header h'a10139ffff' with comment {1: -65537} — the hex decodes to {1: -65536} (39ff.. is off by one; -65537 needs 3a 00010000). Same defect class as the root_dio_signature.py:169 fix (verified: encoder emits a1013a00010000; vectors agree). One-line docstring fix, verify against that file's own encoder/vectors before applying.
close_reason: Re-closing (repeat store-resurrection): key_rotation_attestation.py:151 fix verified in tree (commit 00b7200f69). No new work existed.
